device.type: Handheld DVB-S2 + DVB-T2 + DVB-C combo signal meter and spectrum analyser with 7-inch TFT LCD
device.board: 14050000 (bootloader version "M3516A 1.2.1", 16 MB SPI flash, 256 MB DDR3 M3503/M3516 handheld meter platform)
device.soc: ALi M3516A / M3503 with 256 MB DDR3 (bootloader "M3516A 1.2.1", seecode "M3606 SEE" at 0xAE000200; SDK4.0fa.13.11_20150910)
device.demod: ALi S3501 / internal DVB-S2 + Availink AVL6762 DVB-T2/C

source.note: Archive AMIKO_XFinder2_2.0.48_emu.zip from the Amiko / Amiko HD directory on satedu.cba.pl; fetched 2026-11-01.

simulator.note: Boots as a 256 MB DDR3 M3503 / M3516A board on a 16 MB SPI flash (chips/m3503.py, chip word 0x35030001 for M3503 revision B): the XIP bootloader runs with its stack in the cache-as-RAM window at 0x8FFF8000..0x8FFFFFFF, drives CH455 on SCL = GPIO 135 / SDA = GPIO 134 ("CH455 panel init OK!", " ON "), sets 0xB8000220 bit 24 to remap physical 0x0F000000..0x0FFFFFFF to the top 16 MB of DDR, parks the SEE boot stub at 0xA14187DC, unpacks 3.1 MB seecode ("M3606 SEE") to 0xAE000200 and 11.5 MB maincode(AV) to 0x80000200, and starts both cores (main EBase 0x80002000, SEE EBase 0x8E002001).  The application's PAN_PT6311 driver talks to the handheld meter's Lemontree-protocol MCU at I2C 0x28 on the same GPIO 135 / 134 bus (lemontree_decoder.py, including opcode 0x50 MCU version query and 0x82 LCD backlight enable: "Front Panel init ok"), exchanges 1,800+ SEE RPC calls, prints "ali play 1.0 $$$", and renders its 1920x1080 CLUT8 OSD through GeM36F / GMA layer 0 (without the handheld unit's hardware-ID IC it displays the 14050000 hardware-ID notice).

desc: Firmware 2.0.48 emu (2018-04-10) for the Amiko X-Finder 2 professional handheld DVB-S2 / DVB-T2 / DVB-C signal meter and spectrum analyser with built-in 7-inch TFT LCD, built on the ALi M3516A / M3503 SoC with 256 MB DDR3 and 16 MB SPI flash.

Uses the generic M3516A XIP bootloader (CH455 probe on GPIO 135 / 134) followed by an 11.5 MB handheld-meter application whose PAN_PT6311 driver communicates with the meter's keypad, battery, and LCD-backlight microcontroller at I2C 0x28 using 8-byte CRC-16/XMODEM Lemontree frames.
